svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 72 x 54 mm from 3 mm clear polycarbonate; keep the film on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: both faces until it is bonded.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Score and snap, or saw with a fine blade; file and polish the edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Break the corners 1 mm so the gasket tape does not lift.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay 4 mm wide closed-cell adhesive gasket tape round the underside,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the edge, in one length with a butt joint at the back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: bonded on top of the lid, centred over the 62 x 46 mm opening,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: overlapping it 5 mm at the ends and 4 mm at the sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The hood's tabs and screws sit just outside its ends, 0.75 mm clear.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no gap in the gasket all round; the display reads through it.
